title: Chapter 176 Test-Firing The Catapult
content:
Chapter 176 Test-Firing The Catapult

"Okay, okay, from today on, I appoint you as the military advisor of Wana Village, and you will follow me in the future!" Wang Shuo walked over and patted his shoulder gently, with a particularly bright smile on his face.

"Wenxi, quickly arrange a good place for Yuanjie to live, and send a few sets of clothes over."

"Thank you, Lord!" Zou Yuanjie finally felt relieved and thanked him quickly.

"Yes, Boss!" Duan Wenxi turned his head and looked at Zou Yuanjie again, put his hand on his shoulder and said, "Let's go, I'll pick a big house for you..."

After Duan Wenxi and the others left, Wang Shuo rubbed his head and remembered the two drawings he had obtained, so he got up and walked towards the blacksmith shop, and by the way, see how the light catapult is being studied.

"Mr. Matar, are you there?" Wang Shuo walked into the blacksmith shop and did not see Matar, so he called softly.

"Master, go to the woodworking workshop!"

At this time, Udon jumped out from nowhere and scared Wang Shuo.

"Lord, our catapult has entered the critical assembly period, and we will be able to test it soon." Wu Dong said excitedly.

Wang Shuo was delighted and said happily: "Let's go and take a look."

The house of the woodworking workshop is much higher than the blacksmith shop, and the space inside is at least 10 meters.

The catapult, which is about 5 meters high, has been assembled. Xu Mingzhong and Matar are conducting the final inspection.

"Lord!" Seeing Wang Shuo coming in, everyone saluted.

"You're welcome. How about it, can we test it?" Wang Shuo walked around the huge machine and touched it with his hand.

"Almost done, Lord!" Matar said, and asked someone to push the catapult outside the city gate.

The attack range of the catapult reached an astonishing 3,000 meters. It was a bit difficult to use it inside the city wall. If it hits its own buildings, it would be bad.

Outside the south gate, Wang Shuo specially invited Wana Village, all the high-level people who had no tasks, to watch the test firing experiment of the catapult.

Only 4 soldiers and 4 carpenters who participated in the production had clear division of labor and worked together.

Some were responsible for turning the rope, some were responsible for loading ammunition, and some were responsible for correcting the direction.

Wang Shuo saw this scene and thought to himself that the future war would be very exciting. Whoever could master more large or heavy weapons would definitely take the lead in the war.

"Release." Only one of them gave the order.

The switch of the catapult was triggered, and the projectile was thrown out at high speed, drawing a parabola in the air.

2,500 meters away, a stone pier prepared in advance was immediately blown to pieces.

"Good!" Wang Shuo was the first to applaud. Seeing this result, Wang Shuo was very satisfied.

Not only is the attack distance long, but the power is also huge.

Wang Shuo had a bold idea at this time.

Is it that his city wall has high defense?

Or is his catapult strong in attack?

He immediately ordered people to push the catapult to a place 2000 meters away from the city wall.

After loading the projectiles, Wang Shuo personally triggered the switch.

"Bang."

There was only a huge explosion, which exploded on the city wall.

Wang Shuo hurried to the place where the city wall was blown up and checked the damage.

The attack power of the catapult was as high as 5000, but it did not cause any damage to the durability of the city wall.

Wang Shuo carefully checked it again, and the overall defense of the city wall was still damaged.

It seems that it will take a long time to continue bombarding before it is possible to cause damage to the durability of the city wall.

Wang Shuo was very satisfied with the results of this experiment.

The number of catapults should continue to increase.
